question: A phone keyboard suggests words as you type. It stores 200,000 words. After you type "pre", what is the cheapest way to find every stored word that starts with "pre"?
options: Walk p, r, e down a tree of letters; everything below that node starts with "pre"
Put the words in a hash set and look up "pre"
Sort the words every time a letter is typed
explanation: A trie shares common beginnings, so finding the prefix takes three steps however many words there are. A hash set can only answer exact words, not prefixes.
